main_theorem.rate: Theorem B.5 and Theorem B.6 give O(log(T)/T^{1/3}) averaged convergence bounds in the estimator-error and scaled iterate-displacement metrics; Lemma 3.4 gives the algebraic momentum equivalence used for MARS-Lion/Lion comparison.
main_theorem.statement_math: \text{Theorem B.5. In Algorithm 1, under Assumptions B.1, B.2 and B.3, when choosing }\eta_t=(s+t)^{-1/3},\ s\ge 8L^3/\rho^3.\ \text{Suppose }c\ge 32L^2\rho^{-2}+1,\ \beta_{1,t+1}=1-c\eta_t^2\text{ and }\beta_{2,t+1}=1-\eta_t^6,\text{ then }\forall T\ge s,\text{ it holds that }\frac1T\sum_{t=1}^T\mathbb{E}\|\nabla F(x_t)-m_t\|_2^2\le\left(2\rho G+\frac{\rho c^2\sigma^2}{4L^2}\cdot\log(s+T)\right)\cdot\frac1{T^{2/3}}-\frac{\rho^2\sum_{t=1}^T M_{t+1}}{8L^2T^{1/3}},\quad \frac1T\sum_{t=1}^T\frac1{\eta_t}\cdot\mathbb{E}\|x_{t+1}-x_t\|_2^2\le\left(\frac{16G}{3\rho}+\frac{2c^2\sigma^2}{3L^2}\cdot\log(s+T)\right)\cdot\frac1{T^{2/3}}-\frac{\sum_{t=1}^T M_{t+1}}{6L^2T^{1/3}},\ \text{where }G=F(x_1)-\min_xF(x)+\frac{\rho s^{1/3}\sigma^2}{16L^2}\text{ and }M_{t+1}\text{ is defined in (C.2).}\quad \text{Theorem B.6. In Algorithm 2, under Assumptions B.1, B.2 and B.3, when choosing }\eta_t=(s+t)^{-1/3},\ s\ge\max(8L^3/\rho^3,64\lambda^3).\ \text{Suppose }\|x_t\|_2\le D,\ c\ge32L^2\rho^{-2}+1,\ \beta_{1,t+1}=1-c\eta_t^2\text{ and }\beta_{2,t+1}=1-\eta_t^6,\text{ then }\forall T\ge s,\text{ it holds that }\frac1T\sum_{t=1}^T\mathbb{E}\|\nabla F(x_t)-m_t\|_2^2\le\left(2\rho(G+\lambda D^2\log(s+T))+\frac{\rho c^2\sigma^2}{4L^2}\cdot\log(s+T)\right)\cdot\frac1{T^{2/3}}-\frac{\rho^2\sum_{t=1}^T M_{t+1}}{16L^2T^{1/3}},\quad \frac1T\sum_{t=1}^T\frac1{\eta_t}\cdot\mathbb{E}\|x_{t+1}-x_t\|_2^2\le\left(\frac{16(G+\lambda D^2\log(s+T))}{\rho}+\frac{2c^2\sigma^2}{L^2}\cdot\log(s+T)\right)\cdot\frac1{T^{2/3}}-\frac{\sum_{t=1}^T M_{t+1}}{L^2T^{1/3}}.\ \text{where }G=F(x_1)-\min_xF(x)+\frac{\lambda}{2}D^2(1+\epsilon)+\frac{\rho s^{1/3}\sigma^2}{16L^2}\text{ and }M_{t+1}\text{ is defined in (C.2).}\quad \text{Lemma 3.4. For any sequence }\{g_t\in\mathbb{R}^d\}_{t=0,1,\ldots},\text{ consider the following updates of }m_t\text{ for any constant factors }a_1,a_2,b_1,\text{ and }b_2:\quad u_t=a_1u_{t-1}+a_2g_t,\quad m_t=b_1u_t+b_2g_t.\ \text{The updates are equivalent to }m_t=a_1m_{t-1}+(b_1a_2-a_1b_2+b_2)g_t+a_1b_2(g_t-g_{t-1}).
